written.headline: Review shows AI distillation moving to industrial use in China
written.summary: A review of over 300 Chinese documents shows that AI distillation has moved from academic experiments to widespread industrial use. Chinese entities are adopting sophisticated ways to use output from leading American AI models to train domestic rivals.

written.headline: US Commerce Dept and DOJ investigated Megaspeed over chip exports in 2024
written.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department and Department of Justice investigated Singapore-based Megaspeed starting in 2024 over potential export violations regarding Nvidia chips. Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its no-sell list in June 2025.

written.headline: OpenAI study finds 98% of scientists expect AI to accelerate research
written.summary: An OpenAI study found that 98 per cent of surveyed scientists expect artificial intelligence to accelerate discoveries in their fields. The research analyzed 580,186 scientific messages from 1,819 researchers and a survey of 251 participants using ChatGPT.

written.headline: Amazon's Ohio data center plans face risks after voter restrictions
written.summary: Amazon's planned investments of over $17 billion in Ohio data centers are at risk after midterm voters passed restriction measures affecting proposed projects. Voters in Sunbury, Ohio, approved a ban on large data centers in the November 3 election, raising obstacles for Amazon's proposed US$2 billion project.

written.headline: OpenAI collaborates with NATO and allied cyber agencies on AI defense
written.summary: OpenAI is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help trusted defenders find vulnerabilities, test fixes, and protect essential systems using AI.

written.headline: macOS 27.3 beta adds privacy controls for AI apps and full disk access
written.summary: Apple released the macOS 27.3 beta, splitting the device control setting into two categories and adding restricted folder permissions to address security risks from AI agents. The update introduces a menu bar indicator and prompts users to select specific apps for automation tools to control.

written.headline: Meta modifies Instagram recommendation systems in India to curb violent content
written.summary: Meta modified Instagram's recommendation systems in India to reduce sexually suggestive and violent content from accounts users do not follow. The updates use advanced AI models to filter content proactively across Reels, Explore, and Feed following regulatory scrutiny.
